metadata.description: Rebuild a building from one photograph as a measured IFC/BIM model, authored in Blender through Bonsai

plugins.name: photo-to-ifc-building
plugins.description: Measurement-first single-photo building reconstruction with an IFC deliverable: the method as a skill (measure, solve the camera, author real IfcWall/IfcRoof/IfcWindow entities via Bonsai/ifcopenshell, score renders against the photograph's own pixels, pass the deterministic IFC gate) plus the photo-to-bim MCP server with its measurement instruments (view_crop, trace_edge, solve_camera, unproject, measure_pitch, compare_images, score_render). Requires Blender + Bonsai + a Blender MCP for the authoring side. The skill governs, the tools execute — installing this plugin wires BOTH.
